Paper Crown Films is a Melbourne-based production company founded by New Zealand writer-producer Kevin Patel. The company develops and produces films across multiple genres, pursuing bold ideas with emotional depth. Rooted in both Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand, it champions storytelling that speaks to an international audience—unfiltered, cinematic, and personal.
